quant-research.mission: Improve strategy discovery and validation without weakening no-lookahead, untouched OOS, realistic execution, or fail-closed research rules.

data-market.mission: Improve market-universe coverage, exchange data quality, historical/live integrity, liquidity filters, timestamps, and safe handling of missing or stale data.

strategy-registry.mission: Build longitudinal champion/challenger selection, robust promotion/demotion, drift monitoring, and fail-closed approval gates.

production-risk.mission: Improve live opportunity ranking and portfolio safety while preserving WAIT/NO TRADE behavior and preventing unapproved research from reaching production.

testing-security.mission: Adversarially test the system for security, data leakage, lookahead bias, malformed inputs, CI regressions, and failures that should produce safe WAIT/RESEARCH_ONLY outcomes.
